title: Spells as Functions
tagline: name a piece of work and reuse it
hints: A function is `returnType name(parameters) { ... }`. `int attackDamage(int strength)` means: give me an int called strength, I give you an int back.
Every path through a non-void function must `return` a value. `void` functions return nothing and just end.
Functions must appear ABOVE the place that calls them, so put all three between `roll()` and `main()`.
The bar maths: `int filled = hp * 10 / maxHp;` - and guard it, because a dead monster on negative hp would give you a negative count. `if (hp <= 0) filled = 0;`
To repeat a character, loop: `for (int i = 0; i < filled; ++i) std::cout << '#';` then a second loop printing `.` for the remaining `10 - filled`.
